$comment: Recommended audio channel-layout identifiers used in assets.audio.layout.allowed_layouts. Each token is a hyphenated channel list in EBU R123 / SMPTE broadcast order (L, R, C, LFE, Ls, Rs) — the file-exchange order used throughout EBU R123 (2009) Table 1 and transcribed in the /tools/channel-maps reference. Not enforced by the main schema; adopters may extend.

layouts.description: Stereo pair — Left, Right (EBU R123 2-channel programme mix)
Discrete 5.1 surround in EBU R123 / SMPTE broadcast channel order (L, R, C, LFE, Ls, Rs)
Dual mono — two independent mono channels (e.g. two language services); not a spatial layout
